method.sources: Use Qwen and full GPT-5.4 releases absent from the parent fit, with pinned publisher labels. Within each domain admit a matched Qwen and GPT-5.4 work at each position in a round, up to three pairs per position. Retain one unchanged control per work. Carry forward every position with a matched pair. Exclude earlier recorded work hashes and 12-word phrase overlap against prior and admitted works.
method.comparison: On files with AI-like native context, compare the largest eligible context response with three policies using the parent fitted heads and fixed points. Consider sentences wholly within at least one AI-like native context. Keep the original findings available for every policy.
method.pooled: The combined head must choose a unique highest sentence, exceed the parent's calibration-matched point and select an eligible sentence.
method.agreement: Apply the pooled rule and require the short-context head to choose the same sentence.
method.separated: Apply the agreement rule and require the combined winning score to exceed the runner-up by .10, chosen from the previously exposed position-balanced panel and fixed before this test.
method.advance: A policy can be considered for a local trial if it gets five precise locations never chosen by the native policy on at least four different works with gains on both families, and produces no more new wrong locations than corrections. It must also have at most two precise focuses on genuine works and leave every prior finding and confidence value intact. No verdicts or new findings can be emitted.
